envelope.description: Extend the write-inventory detector and enter the files it newly flags

body.title: Extend the write-inventory detector and enter the files it newly flags
body.summary: In src/workflow/artifact-write-inventory.ts add appendFileSync, appendSidecarLine and an import-based store-write rule to the detector, with negative controls, and add inventory entries for every existing file the detector newly flags (src/daemon/fatal.ts, src/daemon/shutdown.ts, the analyze-step, build-step, workflow-step and review-step handlers, src/config/feedback.ts and the appendRunLog call in src/workflow/storage.ts). It names the new writers by name only, so it does not need the new files to exist.
acceptanceChecks: the detector reports a raw, aliased, renamed, namespace and injected appendFileSync, an unlisted appendSidecarLine and a store write in a file with no entry
the five existing writers are still detected exactly as before
every file under src that the detector now flags has an inventory entry and the inventory test passes

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/artifact-write-inventory.test.ts: the detector reports appendFileSync in every form, an unlisted appendSidecarLine and a store write, and every newly flagged file has an entry
